name: Zylphe
source:
Zylphe is the artificial version of [url=https://vndb.org/c5277]Sylph[/url], created and mass produced by [url=https://vndb.org/c17591]Promestein[/url].

She empowers the wielder with wind, drastically increasing evasion and attack speed which allows for multiple attacks, but also lowering attack power. [url=https://vndb.org/c5278]Gnome[/url] can be used to withstand all of those weak attacks. 

[From [url=https://mgq.miraheze.org/wiki/Zylphe]Mon-musu Quest Wiki[/url]]
